headline: Tata Steel Shares Rise 1% While APL Apollo Falls 9% on ₹28,000 Crore Deal Cautious Views
summary: Tata Steel shares rose 1 percent while APL Apollo shares fell 9 percent after brokerages turned cautious on a major ₹28,000 crore deal.
why: Tata Steel and APL Apollo are major Indian metal and steel product manufacturers sensitive to capital allocation and large corporate transactions.

impacts.name: APL Apollo Tubes Limited
impacts.why: Negative brokerage sentiment surrounding a large corporate transaction puts downward pressure on the stock.
